simple.meaning: נוּחַ (nûwach) is a Hebrew action word meaning “quiet.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in 2 Chronicles, Esther, beginning at 2 Chronicles 6:41. The surrounding contexts include death, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נוּחַ (H5118) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נוּחַ (nûwach) / H5118 is traced through 2 Chronicles 6:41, Esther 9:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.
